name: Perovskite-silicon tandem solar
summary: A perovskite layer above silicon captures additional sunlight that a single silicon cell cannot convert as efficiently.
useCase: A space-constrained roof generates more power from the same panel area, if the new module can maintain output over a bankable lifetime.
whyNow: Research-cell efficiency records and initial commercial shipments demonstrate technical progress. Laboratory efficiency is ahead of proven mass-manufacturing yield and long-term outdoor reliability.

mainstream.scope: Bankable commercial tandem modules used routinely in selected premium or area-constrained solar installations.
mainstream.rationale: Record efficiency gives a strong incentive where area has value. Large-area uniformity, encapsulation, degradation and warranties determine whether premium shipments become a routine choice. Broad commodity market dominance is not assumed.

metric.name: Certified perovskite-silicon research-cell efficiency
metric.scope: Selected champion-cell records from HZB and LONGi; research devices, not average modules
metric.limitations: Performance frontier, not deployed capacity or average commercial panel efficiency. Cell areas, architectures and test certificates differ. Express progress in percentage points, not sector CAGR; the 2026 point is a July record.
metric.futureNote: Oxford PV module-efficiency targets of 27% in 2027 and 30% in 2030 are shown separately; research-cell efficiency and manufactured-module efficiency are different measures.
metric.growthLabel: +5.7 percentage points in selected champion-cell efficiency, 2021–July 2026.

milestones.text: HZB announced a certified 29.80% tandem-cell efficiency record.
No comparable 2022 observation is included in this selected-record series.
LONGi’s retrospective record history identifies 33.9% in November 2023.
LONGi reached 34.6%; Oxford PV announced its first commercial shipment in September.
LONGi announced a 34.85% certified research-cell result in April.
LONGi reported 35.5% certification in July. Oxford PV’s volume-manufacturing expectations remain a forward company plan.

tailwinds: Higher watts per unit area can reduce land and installation pressure
Silicon manufacturing provides an established lower-cell supply chain
Efficiency can offset some additional manufacturing cost
bottlenecks: Large-area coating uniformity, yield and encapsulation
Bankable warranties and cost at meaningful production scale
watchMetrics: Third-party module efficiency and stable outdoor energy yield
Shipped megawatts and warranted lifetime, not research records alone
Manufacturing yield, line throughput and cost per delivered watt
